verdict.rationale: The pack shows Alloy returns evaluation results and service execution status, which lets a user inspect decision outputs. It also says webhooks fire when "a manual review occurs" and markets "fully auditable agentic automation". None of this documents a way to override an automated decision while keeping the original evidence and rationale, so these items are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can inspect and override an automated remediation decision while preserving its original evidence and rationale
